title: dactylorhiza majalis subsp. occidentalis
intro: Dactylorhiza majalis subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as the Western Marsh Orchid, is a type of orchid that belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza and is native to Europe. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza majalis subsp. occidentalis include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve circulation, and reduce inflammation, making it a valuable remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
